events.title: BYU Cougars vs. Cincinnati Bearcats
events.blurb: BYU's final home football game of the regular season, a Big 12 matchup with Cincinnati that kicks off at 1:30 p.m. on FOX.
events.blurbEs: El último partido de fútbol americano en casa de BYU en la temporada regular, contra Cincinnati en la Big 12; empieza a la 1:30 p.m. y se transmite por FOX.

events.title: BYU women's volleyball vs. TCU
events.blurb: The No. 10 Cougars close their regular season on senior night against No. 17 TCU.
events.blurbEs: Las Cougars, número 10, cierran su temporada regular en la noche de seniors contra TCU, número 17.

events.title: Luminaria
events.blurb: A walk-through holiday light show across Ashton Gardens; Friday and Saturday hours are 4 to 9:30 p.m., with last entry at 9:45. Prices vary by date, and it's closed Sundays.
events.blurbEs: Un espectáculo de luces navideñas que se recorre a pie por Ashton Gardens; el viernes y el sábado abre de 4 a 9:30 p.m., con última entrada a las 9:45. Los precios varían según la fecha y cierra los domingos.

events.title: Museum of Natural Curiosity
events.venue: Museum of Natural Curiosity at Thanksgiving Point
events.blurb: A hands-on science museum with a rainforest, a water play area and a toddler zone; it opens at 9 a.m. Friday and Saturday and is closed Sunday. Kids under 3 get in free.
events.blurbEs: Un museo interactivo de ciencias con selva tropical, área de juegos con agua y zona para niños pequeños; abre a las 9 a.m. el viernes y el sábado y cierra el domingo. Los menores de 3 años entran gratis.

events.title: Santa's Grand Arrival
events.blurb: Santa arrives at 9:30 a.m. Friday in the parking lot between Tucano's and The Cheesecake Factory, which kicks off his village season at the mall.
events.blurbEs: Santa llega el viernes a las 9:30 a.m. al estacionamiento entre Tucano's y The Cheesecake Factory, y así comienza la temporada de su aldea en el centro comercial.

events.title: Bryan Callen
events.addr: 190 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
events.blurb: The actor and stand-up comedian plays four shows in The Showroom at the Gateway, about 45 minutes north of Provo. Bring an ID that matches the card used to buy the tickets.
events.blurbEs: El actor y comediante presenta cuatro funciones en The Showroom de The Gateway, a unos 45 minutos al norte de Provo. Lleva una identificación que coincida con la tarjeta usada para comprar los boletos.

events.title: Monte L. Bean Life Science Museum
events.venue: Monte L. Bean Life Science Museum
events.blurb: BYU's free natural history museum with animal exhibits; closed Sundays.
events.blurbEs: El museo gratuito de historia natural de BYU con exhibiciones de animales; cerrado los domingos.
